C8A64-f1.summary: Without the promised Spanish ships and Choiseul's provisions, the governor and intendant order 3,000 barrels of flour and 1,200 of beef from Saint Eustatius, price them, reckon a year's consumption for a siege, and propose paying half in bills of exchange and half in money or produce.
C8A64-f1.en:
[After the clear opening: the British are gathering at Dominica, a second convoy is expected from New England, an
attack is reported from all sides; "this is what we are doing today":]

The Spanish ships (?) that you had announced to us, Monseigneur, having not come, and the relief in provisions
promised (?) by M. (?) the Duc de Choiseul having not come either, we have no provisions, neither in [...] nor
[...], in the colony except for the day-to-day consumption of very (?) few days (?); the [...] is at our door (?).
In this position we thought fit to propose (?) to our [...] of Saint Eustatius that they send us with all speed
three thousand barrels of flour and twelve hundred barrels of beef: the flour at sixty livres (?) the barrel, the
beef at a hundred livres (?) the barrel. [It is] to be believed that the public will pay more for both, unless
there comes about in [...]

C8A63-f208.summary: La Rivière to Berryer: the Saint Eustatius supply contract has broken down; he pays from his own bills; the fall of Belle-Isle does not restore the colony's credit; provisions will hold until December. Code lines with the decipherment of the time above them.
C8A63-f208.en:
The delay in a ship's departure for France lets me tell you the following. Our contract with Saint Eustatius for
our provisioning has broken down, and it could not be replaced, because there are at Saint Eustatius neither beef
nor flour, and none is expected. I turned back quietly; I am taking advantage of several fortunate circumstances
whose combination has suddenly brought a great deal of provisions into the colony. I am paying in large part with
my own bills, at 25 per cent, and I have bought at more than 20 and 25 per cent; [the] contract [is] better than the
price agreed with Saint Eustatius. This leads me to place other funds in the hands of Messrs Delaborde and De
Montmartel, in bills on the treasurers of the colonies. The news of the capture of Belle-Isle does not help to
restore their credit; however that may be, as long as mine can hold, you will want for nothing here.

system: Numerical nomenclator of about 700 groups (values 11-696), probably a two-part syllabic code like the printed Navy form used for Martinique in 1765; clear words embedded in the cipher runs.
